envelope.description: Protocol: 8 new direction-isolated message types + exhaustiveness tests

body.title: Protocol: 8 new direction-isolated message types + exhaustiveness tests
body.summary: Extend vscode-plugin/src/chat/protocol.ts with the eight scratchpad message types, each in its OWN direction's union + const array only (direction-isolated), and update protocol.test.ts exhaustiveness/direction-isolation assertions. Purely additive.
acceptanceChecks: six webview->host types ('scratch-open-menu', titleless 'scratch-new', 'scratch-open' {id}, 'scratch-delete' {id}, 'scratch-browse', 'send-to-chat' {text}) added ONLY to the webview->host union and WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES (protocol.ts:403)
two host->webview types ('scratch-list' {entries, error?}, 'insert-into-input' {text}) added ONLY to the host->webview union and HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES (:378)
protocol.test.ts asserts exhaustiveness, direction isolation (each new type in its own array and NOT the other's), and union/array equality — all passing
payload field names are part of the contract; ids/texts/titles are strings at runtime (non-strings rejected by the host switch)
change is purely additive — no existing message type, union member, or array entry altered

tests.name: protocol.test.ts: all eight new message types appear in their own direction's union + const array only, with direction-isolation and union/array-equality assertions passing (ac5)
